summary: Fixes from an independent review of the Klaviyo CLI: a bound MCP server cannot redirect receipts or deliveries and no command can write into client-profile, credential or database paths; the MCP SQL tool is read-only and single-statement, blocking ATTACH; typed MCP writes send JSON:API objects; legacy adoption and report budgets were fixed in klaviyo-greptile-review-20261109; sync --since sends real time filters (flows with the matching sort), --dry-run has no side effects and capped syncs keep their cursor; qa-gate --campaign-id and templates audit request valid template fields; analytics output is validated; clamped windows drive the calculation; flow aggregate failures surface as errors; report pages retry a 429. Explicit since/until ranges stay on the requested dates and clamp on whole days; MCP report tools send page cursors and filters in the query; flow-path-analysis surfaces aggregate errors; report retries are recorded and a recovered 429 does not mark the run exhausted.
reason: An independent max-effort review traced tenant-isolation holes reachable through the MCP server, sync options that silently did nothing or changed state, and a qa-gate request Klaviyo rejects with HTTP 400 (confirmed live).
validated_outcome: Regression tests for each finding; go build, go vet and go test ./... pass; live against a real Klaviyo account: qa-gate --campaign-id returns a verdict, every sync --since filter is accepted, default receipts still write.
